tracks.name: hol
tracks.description: Prove in HOL4 that submitted RISC-V bytes satisfy the fixed init-e Certificate for the software-precompile EVM guest within a step bound K, and minimize K. Submissions are HOL4 proof sources that the verifier builds and exports in a sandbox, then strictly replays. The initial submission claims infinity.
tracks.hardware: Official runs: blacksmith-32vcpu-ubuntu-2404 (128 GB RAM); proof sources run only in the verifier's Bubblewrap sandbox. Limits: 36,000 s and 64 GiB per author stage, 21,600 s and 112 GiB for strict replay, 75,600 s in total. Upstream's accepted baseline took 39,177 s end to end (13,128 s strict replay, 90.25 GiB max RSS). Cold setup took 7,853 s here; official runs restore it from a cache saved on main.
